text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Today's the Fan Fest… That is, today's the day my life ends…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I can't tell my fans to have a bit of fun and let bygones be bygones. That's not going to cut it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I really screwed up at the Kinko Sho with the way I was acting. My former fans are going to bombard me with questions until there's no trace of me left…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: M-maybe you're right. In a way, this is an opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I want to apologize to them, at the very least. After that, I can live peacefully in some forgotten corner of the Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once all the other events are over, the meet-and-greet commences. Soon, it's Matikanefukukitaru's turn to take the stage.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: H-how am I supposed to interpret this commotion? At least they aren't yelling at me, I guess…

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru, could you tell us your goal for this spring?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Urk… Just getting right to it, huh?! My goal for the spring…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: To quietly enjoy some rice crackers on the veranda and sip some tea. Nice and quiet-like.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, riiight… And what's your next goal after that?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna catch a break here, am I?! What should I do, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Why don't you just tell them?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What?! Are you serious?! Are you seriously serious? Uuugh… If this goes sideways, it's on you…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Actually, I'd like to make an announcement! This spring, my goal—or, I should say—my dream is…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: To race in the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Eeek, I can't believe I just said that!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wait, don't throw things at me! Let's keep the venue nice and clean!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: W-wait, what's going on?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: People are clapping? B-but why?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Sounds good, Matikanefukukitaru! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: You'd better make that wish come true! I'll come and support you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Why are you all being so nice to me? After my performance at the Kinko Sho… It was a disgrace.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: I thought you were hilarious! It was so bad that it was good. You were endearing… in your own way.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: We all have those moments—that feeling when you think you've got it all in the bag, but you don't. I found it pretty relatable.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Relatable? Does this mean you haven't abandoned me yet?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: We're not gonna abandon you. I mean, you tried so hard at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: I'll stick with you through thick and thin. I'm gonna vote for you for the Takarazuka Kinen, okay? Make sure you enter the race after that!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: W-wow, are you all… gods? Buddhas? I can't believe people with this much mercy in their hearts really exist…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I'm crying, I'm sweating… All these fluids are pouring out of me! I can't believe it…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Thank you… Thank you! I'm going to give this another go.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Just like that time I desperately clambered up that cliff to beg for good luck.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry about what happened, everyone. I lost sight of myself!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I promise to try harder in the future. As proof, I'll perform the sacred rite and squat 108 times! So please go on easy on me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Warm laughter fills the venue. Matikanefukukitaru goes on to secure a spot in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm going back to the basics and starting from zero. I know I disappoint you sometimes, but keep watching over me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her gods may have abandoned her, but her fans were there to pick up the pieces. In the end, Matikanefukukitaru manages to secure a spot in the Takarazuka Kinen.
